results.title: NSA Doval urges youth to rise above personal gains and dedicate themselves to national interest
results.description: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval urged India's youth to prioritize national interest over personal gains. He emphasized seizing a crucial window of opportunity for strengthening the nation. Doval accepted the Lokmanya Tilak National Award 2026 in Pune. He praised Lokmanya Tilak's sacrifices and contributions to India's freedom struggle. Doval expressed confidence in India's future success and historical achievements.
